raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Several tests fail under pytest after #36252, #21738 and #41280, or because module-level helpers named test_* are collected as tests.

## Modifications

- Port tests to the current APIs: runtime-context overrides, MultimodalProcessorOutput, run_sgl_eval.
- Rename test_* helpers so pytest stops collecting them.
- Skip Crusoe/KDA tests when their API key or server is absent.
- Set SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN for EAGLE3/DFlash drafts, as the speculative cookbook does.
- Add get/set_embed_and_head to Qwen2MoeForCausalLM (as in Qwen2) for EAGLE drafts.
- Return 0 instead of NaN from the dump comparator for all-zero tensors.

## Accuracy Tests

No model forward or kernel change.
Complete changes were test on A100 backend device environment.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A, test-only change.>

- [✓] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [✓] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [✓] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
